title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Location: Yeovil

Salary: £25,000 - £30,000

Hours: Full-time or Part-time (minimum 30 hours per week)

Working Pattern: Office-based during training, with hybrid working available thereafter

Are you an experienced Payroll Administrator looking to join a friendly and supportive accountancy practice where flexibility, professional development and work-life balance are genuinely valued?

Due to continued growth, a well-established accountancy practice in Yeovil is looking to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join its busy payroll department. Working as part of a close-knit team, you'll be responsible for delivering an accurate and efficient payroll service to a diverse client portfolio while enjoying excellent support and development opportunities.

This opportunity would suit someone with previous payroll experience who enjoys building client relationships, working as part of a team and managing a varied workload in a fast-paced practice environment.

The Role

As Payroll Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing end-to-end payrolls for a portfolio of clients
- Managing weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls
- Processing starters, leavers and contractual changes
- Calculating statutory payments including SSP, SMP and SPP
- Managing pension administration and auto-enrolment duties
- Submitting RTI information to HMRC
- Handling payroll queries from clients and employees
- Maintaining accurate payroll records and ensuring compliance with payroll legislation
- Supporting colleagues within the payroll team during busy periods

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll ideally have:
- Previous payroll experience within an accountancy practice, payroll bureau or in-house payroll environment
- Knowledge of current payroll legislation and processes
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- The ability to work effectively to deadlines
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Experience using payroll software and Microsoft Excel

What's on Offer?

In return, you'll benefit from a supportive and flexible working environment along with an excellent benefits package, including:
- Hybrid working following a successful training and onboarding period
- Flexible working arrangements that can be tailored around personal commitments, including school runs and other family responsibilities
- Full-time or part-time hours available (minimum 30 hours per week)
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Study support towards professional payroll qualifications, including the Level 3 CIPP qualification
- Regular staff socials and team events
- Friendly and collaborative team environment

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing and supportive accountancy practice that genuinely invests in its people. You'll become part of a small team where your contribution is recognised, whilst benefiting from flexible working arrangements, ongoing training and support towards professional payroll qualifications.

If you're looking for a role where you can continue developing your payroll career within a welcoming practice environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply online ASAP, shortlisted applicants will be contacted within 48 working hours.

description:
P/T ACCOUNTS ADMINISTRATOR/BOOKKEEPER

Somerset Solders Ltd, incorporating Somerset Workwear, is an established and growing Somerset business supplying customers across the electronics, construction, medical and transport sectors. We are looking for an experienced and dependable Accounts Administrator to join our small, friendly team. We offer:
- Permanent part-time position - 16 hours per week
- Flexible working hours to be discussed
- Opportunity for some hybrid working once established in the role
- Salary based on experience
- Company pension
- Free on-site parking
- Friendly, supportive small-team environment
- Training on the company ERP system
- Holiday entitlement increases with length of service
- We close between Christmas and New Year, usually around a week
- 20% staff discount off our products

title: Accounts Manager
description:
Account Manager Accountancy Practice

Location: Somerset (office-based across two local offices)
Job Type: Permanent Part-Time (up to 40 hours per week)
Salary: £35,000 £40,000 FTE (depending on experience)

A well-established and growing accountancy practice is looking to recruit an experienced Account Manager to join its friendly and supportive team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced practice accountant who enjoys working closely with a varied client portfolio and is looking for a role offering flexibility, autonomy, and long-term career stability.

The Role

You'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of clients, ensuring a high standard of service across accounts preparation, bookkeeping, VAT, payroll, and general compliance. This is a varied role where you'll build strong client relationships while supporting businesses with their day-to-day accounting requirements.

The successful candidate will have the flexibility to spread their hours across two local offices and should be comfortable travelling between sites when required.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing a portfolio of clients across a range of industries.
- Preparing management accounts, year-end accounts, and financial reports.
- Completing bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, and maintaining accurate accounting records.
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns in line with HMRC requirements.
- Supporting payroll processing where required.
- Managing accounts payable and receivable.
- Assisting with year-end compliance and liaising with senior colleagues where necessary.
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships, acting as a key point of contact.
- Supporting clients with accounting software and day-to-day finance queries.
- Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and HMRC regulations.
- Identifying opportunities to improve internal processes and client service.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent professional qualification.
- A minimum of three years' post-qualified experience within an accountancy practice.
- Experience preparing statutory accounts, VAT returns, payroll, self-assessment tax returns, and limited company accounts.
- Strong working knowledge of cloud accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, or similar.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Strong communication and client relationship skills.
- A proactive and professional approach with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to travel between two local office locations as required.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £35,000 £40,000 FTE, depending on experience.
- Flexible part-time hours (up to 40 hours per week).
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Health and wellbeing initiatives.
- Company events.
- Long-term opportunity within a respected and growing accountancy practice.

If you're an experienced practice accountant looking for a varied client-facing role with flexibility and genuine career stability, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Accounts Technician
description:
A growing accountancy practice is looking to recruit a Senior Accounts Techncian into their Weston-Super-Mare office providing year end accounts, tax and wider service provision to a varied industry client base. You will gain increasing responsibility and technical skill development as you progress within this firm and role.

Client Details

Based in Weston-Super-Mare this accountancy practice acts for a wide ranging and varied client base of sole traders, partnerships, limited company OMBs, SMEs, not for profit/charity and other clients of varying sectors and turnover size. As a result of ongoing growth an opportunity is available for the right Senior Accounts Technician to join the team with excellent benefits, hybrid working, full or part time hours along with competitive salary on offer.

You will join the team as a Senior Accounts Technician where you will take responsibility for the hands on provision of year end accounts preparation, tax, personal and corporate, VAT, bookkeeping and other services to a wide spectrum of clients. Alongside providing a quality compliance service, you will have opportunity for increasing client contact and responsibility looking to build relationships with clients. You will prepare accounts/ tax and provide other services for sole traders , limited companies and partnerships, corporate and personal tax along with other responsibilities . Given the growth in the business and structure of the firm, you will have opportunity to carve a long term career move, with a clear development and progression path on offer, along with full study support for those pursuing qualifications.

Profile

You may be AAT qualified/studying or have developed your career entirely through experience only to date, or be pursuing ACCA/ACA. You will have a background working within the accountancy practice sector specifically as an Accounts Technician / Senior Accountant, or similar level, Accounts and Tax Senior, experienced Semi - Senior etc. You will bring a mix, or any of year end accounts preparation, tax, bookkeeping, VAT etc and be looking for a new challenging career move, where you can see a clear route to progress within a successful team and firm. Study support on offer.

Job Offer

£26,000 - £30,000 + dependent on background and experience, all to be explored. Please apply online and for a further confidential discussion to find out more please contact Mark Bailey on .

description:

This is a hands-on purchasing role supporting project delivery and day-to-day business operations. You will be responsible for sourcing goods and services, obtaining quotations, raising purchase orders, managing supplier relationships and expediting orders to ensure materials are available when required.
The role would suit someone with previous procurement, purchasing or supply chain experience who is highly organised, commercially aware and enjoys working in a busy engineering environment. Responsibilities and duties of the Procurement Coordinator role
- Review project bills of materials and purchasing requirements with project and engineering teams, ensuring quantities, specifications and required dates are understood.
- Identify suitable suppliers and obtain quotations in line with company procedures.
- Compare quotations based on price, lead time, quality, technical requirements and risk, highlighting any significant differences or uncertainties.
- Prepare, raise and administer purchase orders through the appropriate approval process, ensuring all supporting information is complete.
- Maintain accurate procurement records covering quotations, orders, acknowledgements and expected delivery dates.
- Expedite suppliers for order acknowledgements, delivery commitments and progress, identifying late deliveries and potential shortages at an early stage.
- Work with suppliers and the production team to resolve supplier-related issues, including non-conformances, replacement requirements and corrective actions.
- Support supplier approval, assessment and ongoing performance reviews, ensuring supplier records and documentation remain up to date.
- Provide project teams with clear information on purchasing status, material costs, lead times, order progress and delivery risks.
- Highlight where forecast material costs could exceed available project budgets and ensure potential issues are escalated before orders are released.
- Identify opportunities to improve purchasing value, supplier performance, lead times and procurement controls through supplier agreements, consolidation and standardisation.
- Work in accordance with company procedures and ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.

Professional and Personal skills

The Procurement Coordinator role would suit someone who has:
- Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, buying, supply chain coordination or a similar administration role.
- Experience working within an engineering, manufacturing, construction or technical environment would be beneficial.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Experience using purchasing, ERP or business management systems accurately and confidently.
- The ability to obtain and compare supplier quotations, considering price, lead time, quality and risk.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence dealing with suppliers and internal stakeholders by phone and email.
- A proactive approach to chasing outstanding information, resolving issues and ensuring orders progress to completion.
- Good commercial awareness and the ability to recognise when costs, commitments or supplier issues need to be escalated.
- A reliable, adaptable and collaborative approach, with the confidence to work in a growing SME environment.
- Experience within a regulated industry is beneficial but not essential.

Salary and benefits of the Procurement Coordinator role

- 37.5 hours per week

- Health cash plan

- Based at North Petherton, Bridgwater
